subtitle.zh-CN: 用线性代数、概率权重和尺度控制读懂 CNN、Attention 与 Transformer。
subtitle.en: Use linear algebra, probability weights, and scale control to read CNNs, Attention, and Transformers.

aiModelConnections.en: CNNs, Attention, Transformers, residuals, and normalization combine earlier mathematical objects.

plainExplanation.zh-CN: 卷积输出尺寸由输入、padding、kernel 和 stride 共同决定。
plainExplanation.en: Convolution output size is determined by input size, padding, kernel, and stride.

geometricIntuition.zh-CN: kernel 像一个局部窗口，在空间上滑动并共享同一组权重。
geometricIntuition.en: A kernel is a local window that slides spatially while sharing one weight set.

modelConnection.zh-CN: CNN、patch embedding 和局部特征抽取都需要这类尺寸读法。
modelConnection.en: CNNs, patch embeddings, and local feature extraction need this size reading.

description.zh-CN: 每个 head 的特征维度。

plainExplanation.zh-CN: query 和 key 做点积得到相关性，再用 softmax 变成对 value 的加权平均。
plainExplanation.en: Queries and keys form dot-product relevance scores; softmax turns them into a weighted average of values.

geometricIntuition.zh-CN: 每个 token 都根据相似度从其他 token 汇聚信息。
geometricIntuition.en: Each token gathers information from other tokens according to similarity.

numericalExample.zh-CN: 若某个 key 和 query 点积最大，它通常获得最高 attention 权重。
numericalExample.en: If one key has the largest dot product with the query, it usually receives the highest attention weight.

modelConnection.zh-CN: Transformer 的核心计算是并行线性投影、点积、softmax 和矩阵乘法。
modelConnection.en: The core Transformer computation is parallel linear projections, dot products, softmaxes, and matrix multiplications.

title.zh-CN: CNN 是局部共享线性变换
title.en: CNNs Are Local Shared Linear Transforms

content.zh-CN:
卷积层不是“图片专用魔法”。它在局部窗口上重复使用同一组权重。二维输出尺寸常写成

$$
n_{out}=\left\lfloor\frac{n+2p-k}{s}\right\rfloor+1.
$$

这里 \(n\) 是输入尺寸，\(p\) 是 padding，\(k\) 是 kernel，\(s\) 是 stride。手算例子：\(n=32,k=3,p=1,s=1\) 时，输出仍是 32。
content.en:
A convolution layer is not image-only magic. It reuses the same weights over local windows. A common 2D output-size formula is

$$
n_{out}=\left\lfloor\frac{n+2p-k}{s}\right\rfloor+1.
$$

Here \(n\) is input size, \(p\) is padding, \(k\) is kernel size, and \(s\) is stride. Worked example: with \(n=32,k=3,p=1,s=1\), the output size remains 32.

title.zh-CN: Attention 是相似度和概率加权
title.en: Attention Is Similarity and Probability Weighting

content.zh-CN:
scaled dot-product attention 写成

$$
\operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^\top}{\sqrt{d}}\right)V.
$$

\(QK^\top\) 计算 token 之间的点积相似度，除以 \(\sqrt d\) 控制分数尺度，softmax 变成权重，再对 \(V\) 加权求和。它把向量点积、概率分布和矩阵乘法连成一个结构。
content.en:
Scaled dot-product attention is written as

$$
\operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^\top}{\sqrt{d}}\right)V.
$$

\(QK^\top\) computes dot-product similarity between tokens, division by \(\sqrt d\) controls score scale, softmax turns scores into weights, and the weights average \(V\). It combines dot products, probability distributions, and matrix multiplication.

title.zh-CN: Multi-head attention 是 hidden width 的拆分

content.zh-CN:
如果输入是 \`[B,T,H]\`，有 \(N\) 个 head，每个 head 宽度为 \(d\)，则通常要求 \(H=N\cdot d\)。形状会被临时重排成 \`[B,N,T,d]\` 或类似布局，让每个 head 独立计算 \(QK^\top\)。

这个拆分不改变 token 数 \(T\)，也不改变 batch size \(B\)。它让不同 head 能在不同子空间里读取关系。
content.en:
If input shape is \`[B,T,H]\`, with \(N\) heads and per-head width \(d\), then usually \(H=N\cdot d\). Shape is temporarily rearranged to \`[B,N,T,d]\` or a similar layout so each head computes \(QK^\top\) separately.

This split does not change token count \(T\) or batch size \(B\). It lets different heads read relationships in different subspaces.

title.zh-CN: Residual 和 normalization 稳定深层信息流
title.en: Residuals and Normalization Stabilize Deep Information Flow

content.zh-CN:
残差连接把层写成

$$
\mathbf{y}=\mathbf{x}+F(\mathbf{x}).
$$

这给信息和梯度提供更直接的路径。Normalization 则控制中间激活的均值和尺度，减少深层堆叠时的数值漂移。它们不是用来替代学习，而是让很深的组合更容易优化。
content.en:
A residual connection writes a layer as

$$
\mathbf{y}=\mathbf{x}+F(\mathbf{x}).
$$

This gives information and gradients a more direct path. Normalization controls the mean and scale of intermediate activations, reducing numerical drift in deep stacks. These mechanisms do not replace learning; they make very deep compositions easier to optimize.

title.zh-CN: 把结构读成前置数学对象的组合
title.en: Read Architectures as Compositions of Earlier Math

content.zh-CN:
CNN、attention、residual 和 normalization 看起来是不同模块，但都能拆回前置数学对象：局部线性变换、点积、softmax、矩阵乘法、向量范数和尺度控制。

学生读新模型时，可以先问三个问题：shape 怎么流动？哪些维度被求和或拆分？概率权重或归一化在哪里改变尺度？这样比背每个架构名更稳。
content.en:
CNNs, attention, residuals, and normalization look like different modules, but they decompose into earlier mathematical objects: local linear transforms, dot products, softmax, matrix multiplication, vector norms, and scale control.

When reading a new model, ask three questions first: how does shape flow, which dimensions are reduced or split, and where do probability weights or normalization change scale? This is more robust than memorizing architecture names.
